# Where Goes Rose?

> > Budget travel blog featuring solo female travel guides, backpacking itineraries, and street food adventures across Europe, Asia, the Americas, and Oceania.

Where Goes Rose? is a travel resource created by Rose, specializing in budget-conscious travel with a focus on the Balkans, Eastern Europe, Mexico, and emerging destinations. The site offers practical city guides, solo female travel advice, and cultural insights including street art and local cuisine.

## Key Topics

- Solo female travel
- Budget travel
- Backpacking
- Balkans travel
- Eastern Europe
- Mexico City
- Street food
- Travel itineraries
- Europe travel
- Street art
- Destination guides
- Oxford
- Romania
- Asia travel
- Central America backpacking

## Essential Travel Resources

- [Resources](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/resources): Travel resources: booking tools, transportation & insurance recommendations

## Europe & Balkans Travel Guides

- [United Kingdom](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/united-kingdom): UK travel guide: England, Scotland, Wales budget tips & city guides
- [Oxford](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/united-kingdom/england/oxford): Oxford hometown guide: food, Harry Potter sites & Jericho itineraries
- [Croatia](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/europe/croatia): Croatia guide: Dubrovnik, Split, islands & solo travel itineraries
- [Romania](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/europe/romania): Romania road trip: Timisoara, Bucharest, Transylvania & Brasov guide
- [Bulgaria](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/europe/bulgaria): Bulgaria travel guide: Sofia, Rila Monastery & 7 Rila Lakes tips
- [Hungary](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/europe/hungary): Hungary guide featuring Budapest city break, food & culture tips
- [Poland](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/europe/poland): Poland travel guide: Warsaw, Gdansk & Eastern Europe tips
- [Austria](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/europe/austria): Austria guide: Vienna itinerary, Naschmarkt & street art tips
- [Denmark](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/europe/denmark): Denmark guide: budget Copenhagen tips & Freetown Christiania visit
- [North Macedonia](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/europe/north-macedonia): North Macedonia guide: Skopje, Lake Ohrid & Balkans backpacking
- [Kosovo](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/destinations/europe/kosovo): Kosovo travel guide: Pristina & Balkans destination overview
